answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one meadow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 39 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 40 times the capital for one share. The signal report makes public the merge explicitly at each anchor. A farm of 965 identities would post 4281 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
